What the record says

  • The Bills' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is favored by 0.5 to 3 (since 2002): 46-29-2 against the spread, a 61.3% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is road favorite (all time): 63-78-5, 44.7%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is 38 to 41.5 (52-46, 53.1% over) and least often at 42 to 44.5 (45-54-1, 45.5%).
  • All time they have covered 51.5% at home and 47.8% on the road, a 3.7 point edge at home.
